execution: Local pinned sources treated as inert input. Java and Python use the original case-file rule mapping. Framework and DOM policy agreement use the frozen evaluation protocol. The maintainer held the DOM cohort blind to the detector developer until the candidate commit was fixed.
resources: Each variant ran serially on a shared host. Per-CWE wall/CPU samples surround each direct domain call and sampled RSS is a process-wide point reading after the call. Process peak RSS covers the whole command. Timings cannot establish a production performance or latency change. Java/Python and file-scoped framework assays use direct in-process analysis with no worker deadline. Trace-gap counters report what the engine recorded. An unknown dynamic path may remain even when no resource gap was reported.

dom-policy.interpretation: Previously unused upstream dangerous-DOM-assignment rule-policy agreement. Sealed baseline opened after candidate commit. Generic origins may be unknown.

wholeRepository.locationDenominator: Four published preselected sites. Source matching includes same-file detections and separately reports exact labelled lines.

frontendSamples.design: Seven alternating pairs of fresh Node processes. One file warm-up per process. Time for Git blob reads excluded. Peak RSS includes dependencies, fixture read and parsing. No type checker, config, transforms or package scripts.
